cs at 400 epochs, both arms - completing the epoch-budget sensitivity.

Photo and Computers are done and they disagree about what the longer budget does
to the ranking:

  photo      200 ep: OUTPOST - DEMO = -0.0029 (tie, p=0.45)
             400 ep: OUTPOST - DEMO = -0.0176 (LOSS, p=0.015)
  computers  200 ep: +0.0529 (win)
             400 ep: +0.0634 (bigger win, 25/25 rotations)

The budget is not a neutral protocol constant. Under best-over-epochs selection
more epochs can only help, and it helps the two methods by DIFFERENT amounts -
DEMO gains 0.048 on photo where OUTPOST gains 0.033 - so the ranking on photo
inverts with a quantity most papers report in a single word, if at all.

cs is the remaining small graph and the one where OUTPOST's margin over published
DEMO is largest, so it is where a budget-induced flip would matter most. Both arms
at 400, same five seeds, sharded by rotation.
